title: Yellowy Greek Eggplant Moussaka
description: A classic Greek dish with a twist, featuring kinako and deep fried eggplant, this moussaka is a hearty and comforting meal. It is kosher friendly and perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep fry the eggplant slices in hot oil until they are golden brown and crispy.
In a large pan, cook the ground beef over medium heat until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the kinako to the pan with the ground beef and stir to combine.
In a separate saucepan, heat the tomato sauce over low heat.
In another saucepan, heat the bechamel sauce over low heat.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices.
Spread half of the tomato sauce over the eggplant, followed by half of the bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers, starting with the eggplant, then the remaining tomato sauce, and finally the remaining bechamel sauce.
Sprinkle the parmesan cheese over the top of the moussaka and drizzle with olive oil.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
